title: Earn honestly and let some leave your hand
summary: This meets the split between livelihood and devotion. The line refuses the split: honest work and sharing are part of the path itself.
takeaway: Keep earning and giving in one sentence.
lifeApplication: When money becomes only accumulation, interrupt it with one deliberate gift. Let earning and giving stay in the same spiritual sentence.

source.shortMeaning: The path is known in honest earning and open-handed giving.
source.lifeApplication: When money hardens into accumulation, interrupt it with one deliberate gift.

evidence.coreClaim: The path is known in honest earning and open-handed giving.
evidence.turn: Honest labor and sharing reveal the path better than costume.
evidence.practicalImplication: When money becomes only accumulation, interrupt it with one deliberate gift. Let earning and giving stay in the same spiritual sentence.
